title: Automations: after the Mac sleeps through two runs, one late catch-up runs and the missed one is skipped

steps.title: Two automations made; the runner is off (the Mac asleep)
cmux: clear; cmux automation create 'Every minute' --command 'echo checked disk' --every 1m >/dev/null && cmux automation create 'Morning brief' --prompt 'Summarize my open pull requests' --weekdays 09:00 >/dev/null; cmux automation runner status

steps.title: Automations page: Automations are off on this Mac, with Turn On
The runner starts again (the Mac wakes)
cmux: (cmux automation runner >"$TMPDIR/automation-runner.log" 2>&1 & r=$!; sleep 60; kill $r) >/dev/null 2>&1 & disown; sleep 4; cmux automation history 'Every minute'

steps.title: One late catch-up run; the earlier missed minute skipped with its reason
